name: Customer-Managed Key (CMK) workspace encryption lifecycle
description: Enable, verify, rotate, tenant-audit, and reset Customer-Managed Key (CMK) encryption for Fabric workspaces programmatically. Fabric encrypts data at rest with Microsoft-managed keys by default; CMK wraps that with your own Azure Key Vault key. The CMK REST APIs are GA, so this is fully scriptable for provisioning-time enablement, scheduled rotation, and tenant-wide encryption governance/drift detection.
prerequisites: Authenticated via fabio auth login (or FABIO_ACCESS_TOKEN)
An Azure Key Vault key with a VERSIONLESS key URI (https://<vault>.vault.azure.net/keys/<key>) — Fabric rotates through the versionless URI
The Fabric workspace identity granted Key Vault permissions (Get/Wrap/Unwrap Key) on that key
Workspace Admin role for per-workspace encryption changes; Fabric Admin role for the tenant-wide audit (admin list-workspaces)

steps.description: Inspect the current encryption state before changing anything (CMK applied? which key? status Enabled/EnableInProgress/Failed?).
steps.notes: Ideal for validation, auditing, and drift detection. Read-only.

steps.description: Enable CMK on the workspace (or update to a different key). Sets keyIdentifier.
steps.notes: The key URI MUST be versionless. Because it is versionless, KEY ROTATION flows through this SAME command — re-run assign-encryption after rotating the key material in Key Vault.

steps.description: Poll until status becomes Enabled (it transitions through EnableInProgress).
steps.notes: A Failed state usually means the workspace identity lacks Key Vault permissions on the key.

steps.description: Tenant-wide governance: find every workspace mid-enablement (or Failed/Active) across the tenant in one call.
steps.notes: Requires Fabric Admin. include=encryption adds each workspace's encryption block; --encryption-status filters server-side (Active | EnableInProgress | DisableInProgress | Failed | Disabled).

steps.description: Scope the tenant encryption audit to a single capacity (e.g. verify all workspaces on a regulated capacity are CMK-protected).
steps.notes: Combine with --encryption-status. --capacity-id maps to the API's capacityId filter.

steps.description: OPTIONAL: revert the workspace to Microsoft-managed keys (disables CMK).
steps.notes: Only when decommissioning CMK for a workspace. Confirm with the data owner first.

tips: Rotation is idempotent through the versionless URI: rotate the key in Key Vault, then re-run 'workspace assign-encryption' with the same --key-identifier to have Fabric pick up the new version.
Provision-time enablement: call 'workspace assign-encryption' right after 'workspace create' so data is CMK-wrapped from the start.
Scheduled fleet audit: 'fabio admin list-workspaces --include encryption --query "[?encryption.status!='Active'].id"' surfaces workspaces not fully CMK-protected.
All CMK APIs honor existing workspace/tenant-admin permissions — only authorized identities can view or change encryption posture.
See the Customer-managed keys for Fabric workspaces documentation for Key Vault setup and required workspace-identity permissions.
